dynamic_root_gitlinks.required_preservation: Preserve every legitimate current upstream root gitlink and tree entry; only an explicitly reviewed datasets contribution may advance external/ipfs_datasets.

limitations: Point-in-time upstream and local metadata audit only. No private bodies, saved scores, checkpoint JSON, model or resource execution occurred. Root owns source-only publication and should recheck main if integration is delayed. All current legitimate upstream progress remains intact; a prepared source plan does not authorize training.
